hostname.description: Publicly visible server name shown in server browser.

port.description: Main UDP port used for gameplay traffic (must be open in firewall).

queryport.description: UDP port used for server queries (browser, status). Often same as port.

mapcyclefile.description: Relative or absolute path to map rotation file. Relative paths resolve relative to server root.

dedicated.description: Run in dedicated server mode (no local client). Required for public servers.

lanserver.description: Hide server from public master server lists (LAN-only).

rcon_password.description: Password to authenticate remote admin commands (leave empty to disable).

log_chat.description: Log chat messages to file (requires logfile to be set).

logfile.description: Path to server log file (relative or absolute).

idlekick.description: Seconds of inactivity before kicking a player (0 = disable).

timeleft.description: Seconds between console announcements of remaining time (0 = off).

defaultmap.description: Fallback map if mapcycle loading fails or is empty.

voice_rate.description: Voice packet interval in milliseconds (lower = higher quality, more bandwidth).

maxclients.description: Upper bound on voice clients (must be ≥ maxplayers).

items.description: Custom cvars shown as server rules in browser

name.description: Human-readable name for the rule (used only in comment)

server_rules.description: List of cvars to expose as server rules (e.g., for mod-specific settings).

items.description: Commands executed automatically on each map change

map_change_commands.description: List of commands to run on every map change (e.g., to enforce mod rules).

extra_cvars.description: Custom configuration overrides not covered by other sections.

whitelist_file.description: Optional path to whitelist file (one SteamID/IP per line).
